question: Who enters the forest in Silappadikaram?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Senguttuvan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Senguttuvan** is one of the prominent characters in the Tamil epic **Silappadikaram**, written by Ilango Adigal.
 
• He is portrayed as the **Cheran king**, also known as Chera Senguttuvan, who is a symbol of justice and valor in Tamil literature.
 
• Senguttuvan enters the forest to procure a sacred stone, which is used to carve an idol of the goddess **Kannagi**, the central character of Silappadikaram.
 
• The episode of Senguttuvan entering the forest signifies the importance of devotion, justice, and dedication to righteousness in Tamil culture.
 
• Silappadikaram, one of the five great epics of Tamil literature, highlights the cultural and ethical values of the Tamil people, with Senguttuvan playing a significant role in honoring Kannagi’s virtue.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cheran:**

 
 
• The Cheras were one of the three ancient Tamil dynasties, along with the Cholas and Pandyas.
 
• Cheran rulers were known for their contributions to Tamil literature and culture.
 
• Senguttuvan, as a Cheran king, is remembered for his justice and devotion to Kannagi.
 
 
 
• **Cholan:**
 
 
• The Cholas were an ancient Tamil dynasty known for their maritime achievements and temple architecture.
 
• They ruled large parts of South India and Southeast Asia at the height of their power.
 
• Although not directly related to the main events of Silappadikaram, the Cholas are significant in Tamil history.
 
 
 
• **Ilango:**
 
 
• Ilango Adigal, the author of Silappadikaram, was a Chera prince and the younger brother of Senguttuvan.
 
• He renounced his claim to the throne and became an ascetic, dedicating his life to literature and spirituality.
 
• His work, Silappadikaram, is a masterpiece of Tamil literature and provides deep insights into ancient Tamil culture and values.
 
 
 
• **Silappadikaram:**
 
 
• Silappadikaram is one of the five great Tamil epics, written during the Sangam period.
 
• The story revolves around Kannagi, who seeks justice for her husband Kovalan's wrongful execution.
 
• The epic reflects themes of love, betrayal, justice, and the cultural ethos of ancient Tamil society.
